symptom: Re-running `describe association|java action|module role` output against the project it came from fails: "association 'X' already exists — use 'create or modify association'", "java action already exists", "module role already exists". A describe → exec round trip dies at the first statement
cause: Those three describers (and `describe module`'s role lines) printed a plain `create`; every other describer already printed `create or modify`
insight: A describe that emits plain `create` does not just fail loudly — it HIDES every loss behind it, because nothing downstream runs. Fixing the verb immediately surfaced #704 (association Table→Column) and the Java action's ExportLevel loss. Test the verb by parsing the output (CreateOrModify on the AST), not by grepping the text
